models.title: Qwen 3.5 0.8B
models.blurb: The smallest useful model: quick on any processor, reads photos. Good for short questions, not long tasks.

models.title: Qwen 3.5 2B
models.blurb: Small enough for a laptop processor, still reads screenshots and photos.

models.title: Phi-4 Mini
models.blurb: A 3.8B model that is good at maths and step-by-step answers for its size. Text only.

models.title: Gemma 4 E2B
models.blurb: Google's model for phones and laptops: light, multilingual, reads images.

models.title: Llama 3.2 3B
models.blurb: Compact and quick on modest hardware. Picks the wrong tool often (22 of 31 real tasks).

models.title: Qwen 3.5 4B
models.blurb: Quick replies and reads screenshots and photos. Runs on laptops.

models.title: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B
models.blurb: Fast and light with a long memory. Passed 26 of Lotus's 31 real tasks in about two minutes.

models.title: Gemma 4 E4B
models.blurb: The bigger of Google's laptop models: better writing and reasoning than E2B, reads images.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
models.blurb: NVIDIA's newest small model (October 2026), built for tool use and coding on small GPUs. Text only in Lotus.

models.title: Qwen 3 8B
models.blurb: The best tool user Lotus has tested on an 8 GB GPU: 30 of 31 real tasks.

models.title: Qwen 3.5 9B
models.blurb: Newer than Qwen 3 8B and reads images; a tight fit on an 8 GB card.

models.title: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B
models.blurb: Tuned for writing and reviewing code.

models.title: DeepSeek-R1 8B
models.blurb: Shows its reasoning before answering.

models.title: Gemma 4 12B
models.blurb: Strong all-rounder with vision and tool use. Great for daily chat.

models.title: Qwen 3 14B
models.blurb: The bigger Qwen 3: more knowledge and steadier long answers than the 8B. Text only.

models.title: gpt-oss 20B
models.blurb: OpenAI's open model: quick for its size because only part of it works on each word. Text only.

models.title: Mistral Small 3.2 24B
models.blurb: A careful writer that follows instructions closely and reads images. Strong in European languages.

models.title: Gemma 4 26B A4B
models.blurb: Nearly as smart as Gemma 4 31B but answers about as fast as a 4B model.

models.title: Qwen 3.8 27B
models.blurb: The strongest open model that fits one 24 GB card (August 2026): agents, coding, reasoning, images.

models.title: Qwen 3.6 27B
models.blurb: Qwen 3.8 27B's predecessor; well tested by the community for coding and agents.

models.title: Qwen 3.5 27B
models.blurb: The February 2026 27B: strong reasoning and writing, reads images. Qwen 3.6 and 3.8 27B are newer.

models.title: Qwen 3 Coder 30B A3B
models.blurb: A fast coding model: writes, fixes and explains code across a whole project. Text only.

models.title: Gemma 4 31B
models.blurb: Google's largest open model: excellent writing and many languages, reads images.

models.title: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B
models.blurb: Big knowledge, small-model speed: only 3B of its 35B work on each word. Needs a 32 GB card or Mac to fit well.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B
models.blurb: NVIDIA's fast agent model (August 2026) with a very long memory. Text only; needs 32 GB.

models.title: gpt-oss 120B
models.blurb: OpenAI's large open model. Needs about 70 GB of memory: a 96 GB Mac or a workstation. Text only.

models.title: Qwen 3.5 122B A10B
models.blurb: The largest model here; reads images. Needs a 128 GB Mac or a workstation.

models.title: FLUX.2 Klein 4B
models.blurb: Four steps, about a second per image on a modern GPU. Ideal for drafts.

models.title: Z-Image Turbo
models.blurb: Photoreal images in eight steps, with readable text in English and Chinese.

models.title: Qwen-Image
models.blurb: A 20B model with the best prompt following and text rendering here.

models.title: FLUX.2 Klein 4B (small)
models.blurb: The 4-step FLUX.2 Klein in a smaller file: drafts and photo edits on a 6 GB card. Lotus's own engine only.

models.title: Z-Image Turbo (small)
models.blurb: Photoreal images with readable text in eight steps, sized for 8 GB cards. Lotus's own engine only.

models.title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B (small)
models.blurb: Sharper and more varied than Klein 4B, still four steps. Personal, non-commercial use only. Lotus's own engine only.

models.title: Qwen-Image (small)
models.blurb: Qwen-Image's prompt following and text rendering in a 13 GB file, for 16–24 GB cards. Lotus's own engine only.

models.title: Stable Diffusion XL
models.blurb: The classic 1024 px model most LoRAs are made for. Comes with the fixed SDXL VAE.

models.title: Stable Diffusion 1.5
models.blurb: Small and fast 512 px model with thousands of add-ons. The only image model that is bearable without a graphics card (about a minute an image).

models.title: Kokoro
models.blurb: 82M parameters, 50 ready-made voices, fast even without a GPU.
